system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The Yoton clan are a varied and truly unique clan within the land of Earth. Often mistaken for 4 different clans, due to the variety of techniques available to them. You are able to utilize one of the many variants of Lava release. Select one Magma Variant. This cannot be changed later. Hijutsu you cast or maintain use your Magma Variant’ listed abilities. You can select another variant at 7th and 15th levels. If you select a Variant you already previously selected, you gain its listed Intensity I ability. You gain their Intensity II ability if you select the same variant a 3rd time. Magma Variant abilities use your highest jutsu save DC for effects that call for it.

Regardless of the Magma Variant you have, they all have the following ability;

Molten Terrain. As a Bonus Action you can select a point you can see no more than 60 feet away and make a 10-foot cube, centered on this point becomes Molten Terrain. You can only have 1 active Molten Terrain at once. This increases to 2 at 11th level. Molten Terrain, lasts for 1 minute. Placing more Molten Terrain, than you can maintain dispels the oldest Molten Terrain, currently active.

Onyx

You can reshape the environment into one where you have the advantage. Once per turn, as part of casting a Hijutsu, or as a Bonus action, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you, as a shard of Onyx erupts from the point, radiating your molten chakra for the next minute. You can only have 1 Onyx shard active at a time. Conjuring more than you can currently maintain, dispels the oldest shard All creatures within 10 feet of this shard of onyx make saving throws against effects that reduce their speed, Grapple, Restrain or knock them Prone at disadvantage. Increase the number of Onyx you can have active by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Intensity I: Onyx that you conjure also become Earthen Artifacts. Additionally, hostile creatures that cast a Barrier within your Onyx’s aura has its cost increased by +8.

Intensity II: While you have two or more Onyx shards active, and standing in the aura generated by both at the same time, you gain resistance to the first instance of damage you take each turn.

Quicklime

| Molten / [Elemental] / A Molten creature is coated in molten rock and fire, setting them up for cataclysmic elemental reactions. Once a creature takes one of the listed elemental damage types this condition applies the listed effect. / This condition ends at the end of the affected creature’s next turn unless otherwise specified. / A Molten creature that takes earth damage, has the molten matter on them harden, reducing their speed by half and they cannot cast jutsu with the M (mobility) component until the end of their next turn. / A Molten creature that takes wind damage, has the molten matter on them burst, spreading to all creatures within 10 feet of them, applying the Burned condition. This condition then immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes fire damage has the molten material heat up radiating extreme heat, applying 2 ranks of the Burned condition. This condition then immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes cold damage has their body become brittle, becoming vulnerable to the next instance of Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage they take. If they take Bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage before the end of their next turn, this condition immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes lightning damage has lightning arc to all creatures within 10 feet of them, applying the Shocked condition. This condition then immediately ends. / Creatures that are immune to Fire and Earth damage is immune to this condition. |

You can reshape the environment into one where hostile creatures can’t move freely. Molten Terrain you conjure increase their size by +5 feet and the number of Molten Terrains you can maintain by +1. Increase the size of your Molten Terrain by an additional +5 at 7th and 15th levels.

Intensity I: Hostile creatures that that would attempt to leave your Molten Terrain, must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they cannot move into a space unaffected by your Molten Terrain until the end of the current turn.

Intensity II: Hostile creatures that cast a jutsu with the HS (Hand Sign) component while under the effects of a Hijutsu you cast, must first make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, their jutsu casting is Interrupted.

Volcanic

You can reshape the environment into one where wading through it is actively detrimental. When a creature first enters your Molten Terrain they make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they become Molten.

Intensity I: If you cast a jutsu with the Earth or Fire release keywords that affect an area, and their effect area crossed your Molten Terrain, the area they affect increases in size by +10 feet.

Intensity II: When you create Molten Terrain as a Bonus Action, increase its size by +10 feet. Additionally, creatures within 5 feet of the selected point makes the next saving throw they make vs a jutsu with the Fire or Earth release keywords at disadvantage, before the beginning of your next turn.

Rubber

You can reshape the environment into one where it protects you and your allies. Jutsu you cast with the Fire or Earth release keywords, with a range of Self, that provides you temporary hit points, DR, or summons a Barrier, for you, gin a range of 30 feet and can be cast targeting a willing allied creature, applying its effect to the select creature as if they cast it. Additionally, Earthen Artifacts, within your Molten Terrain, that don’t have listed hit points, gain 20 hit points

Intensity I: Allied creatures within your Molten Terrain, have resistance to Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing and lightning damage. Additionally, by spending 4 of an Earthen Artifacts hit points that is within your Molten Terrain, you gain grant one allied creature, also within your Molten Terrain, one additional resistance that lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Intensity II: If you have an active Earthen Artifact that has its own hit points, allied creatures within your Molten Terrain that take damage, can have up to half of the damage they take, transferred to the Earthen Artifact. If the damage they would transfer to the Earthen Artifact would exceed its current hit points, any remaining transferred damage goes back to the original ally.
